## Foreign Investors Remain Net Sellers of Korean Assets for Sixth Consecutive Month: BOK

Persistent foreign net selling of Korean assets for six months is a structural overhang for Samsung and SK Hynix held by global tech PMs — even if individual company fundamentals are improving (e.g., Temasek interest, HBM demand), sustained capital outflows can suppress multiple expansion and create technical selling pressure.

- Bank of Korea data shows foreigners were net sellers of Korean assets in July, extending the streak to six consecutive months.
- The sustained capital outflow is a persistent macro headwind for Korean equity exposure broadly.
- The signal is cross-asset and geopolitical in nature, affecting both equity and fixed income markets.
- No breakdown by asset class or magnitude of outflows is specified in the headline.
